body:
PM handoff — PR #11 accepted; one event-window repair authorized

EARWORM_MERGED_SHA=a26bda233a3cfba40e7a79fbb0e290fd3f3c66fb
EARWORM_NEXT_INSTRUCTION_SHA=a26bda233a3cfba40e7a79fbb0e290fd3f3c66fb
EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-event-window-repair-v1
Instruction version: 1

Source: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/11
Reviewed publication: a26bda233a3cfba40e7a79fbb0e290fd3f3c66fb
Confirmed merge / exact next base: 95ab026b65ea9b85fce89c4698a1b9092ada5876
Review: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/11#pullrequestreview-5260034913
Original held-out execution: d50e24a6e0e847b4099a1ac05971dea7a5d6bbba

Selected branch B: accept the negative-result snapshot, withhold adoption of the streaming front, and do not advance musical complexity yet. Independent saved-only checks reconstructed 9,072 forecasts, verified 22,268 log records and 358 historical hashes, and reproduced the branch. Oracle-boundary retrieval was 48/48 per cell; streaming was 36/48,12/48,9/48,8/48. Coarse event F1 .971803 coexists with pitch accuracy .674921. Wrong inferred spans sometimes include neighboring sound; different bounds alone do not prove the cause or a remedy. The following tests that remedy rather than commissioning another descriptive audit. Original unmodified verifier has a nonblocking exact-float comparison portability issue (one score differs by 1.11e-16); preserve it, use explicit numerical tolerances in new saved-output validation.

Authorization: one implementation-AND-run assignment delegated under Brian's continuous 24/7 roadmap authority. Reconcile completion receipt 5748532947, live main/PRs and local progress, processed comment/version/assignment/SHA tracking and no-overlap lock before starting. No matching active successor was present at handoff. Reuse matching work if it now exists; never restart completed work or dispatch another worker.

Which finish-line capability does this assignment establish or unblock? Reliable causal event-derived measurements from continuous audio, prerequisite to transformed-material recognition and history-conditioned forecasts without supplied note boundaries. This is NOT a long-term-retention test; the top goal, finite checklist and release acceptance plan remain intact.

Decision: should a versioned causal interior-window measurement policy replace whole inferred-span measurement in the current streaming front?
Result A → if the repaired policy meets every adoption/control/safety gate below, retain it as the next bounded streaming prototype; after review move to a decision-qualified isolated-voice recognition/transformation milestone rather than another boundary audit.
Result B → if oracle remains sound but the repair fails or regresses, do not adopt it and do not advance complexity. Preserve both versions; the PM chooses a different localized event/measurement approach only if fresh evidence gives a concrete discriminating decision.
Result C → if oracle also fails, withhold attribution to event windows and retain only the previously demonstrated supplied-boundary claim; the PM chooses the identified task/observation prerequisite.
Invalid/inconclusive → no adoption or post-hoc rerun. Preserve evidence, stop for review; PM makes the next in-plan choice under the decision filter, or checkpoints a genuine blocker.
Stop condition: finite development, one frozen evaluation, one complete successor snapshot with all outcomes, then awaiting-review and stop. No worker self-dispatch.

IMPLEMENT AND RUN ONE LOCAL REPAIR

Create experiments/event-window-repair-v1/ from exact main 95ab026b65ea9b85fce89c4698a1b9092ada5876. Preserve ALL historical packages including E08 and PRs8–11 byte-for-byte. Keep PR11's selected b2 event formation, 64ms arrival chunks, 32ms/4ms frame extraction, event confirmation/state rules, accepted PR10 NSDF estimator/config and PR8 simple retrieval/config frozen. Change only selection of the causal acoustic support used to derive a completed event's measurement. No pitch snapping to expectations, oracle spans, generator metadata, new encoder, new predictor training or broader segmentation redesign in this stage.

Test a bounded interior-support policy intended to avoid transition-contaminated samples. Before development execution declare at most six candidate policies (e.g. symmetric 8/16/24ms trims and/or deterministic stable-interior selection using only the already-arrived frozen frame observations). Select ONE on development only with a fixed objective/tie-break. Require a contiguous support interval wholly inside the inferred completed event, minimum 32ms and sufficient cycles for its reported pitch under a preregistered rule; insufficient evidence stays unavailable/uncertain, never falls back to true boundaries. Do not add another repair family after evaluation. If development cannot produce a feasible policy within the caps, checkpoint that concrete failure instead of consuming evaluation or expanding scope.

Preserve the full captured PCM and original untrimmed observation, candidate evidence and uncertainty as immutable records; append the new measurement with its support indices/hash and actual availability/computation timestamps. Do not replace evidence with a pitch label or erase timbre/dynamics/duration differences. Keep whole-event duration/bounds and original spectral measurements separately: a pitch-support crop must not silently redefine event duration or the captured realization. No context-dependent rewriting of observations. Keep agents outside the listener.

COMPARISON AND FRESH DESIGN

Forty fresh disjoint normalized motif/continuation groups: 8 development,8 calibration,24 evaluation, with all variants in one split and no prior motif-family/evaluation overlap. Preserve PR11's four controlled cells (detached,legato,duration-jitter,joint timbre/duration/legato), distributional task and explicit rendering limitations; use fresh seeds and byte hashes. This tests a new policy, not the old exposed groups again. Do not remove difficult rendering families or change the evaluation distribution after development.

Compare repaired support, unchanged PR11 whole-span streaming, fixed-window/no-event, and evaluator-only oracle-boundary ceiling on the SAME arrived streams. The oracle is never operational. Give present-only/marginal, recency, transitions1–3, absolute and transformation-aware retrieval equal observations/history budgets within each front. Preserve PR8 branch B; no attempt to manufacture relational superiority.

Keep byte-identical current probes, balanced paired source-sound inventories/counts/frequencies/durations/timbre/energy, balanced order/recency and equal capacity with zero eviction. Declare unavoidable factor aliases. Keep reset, relevant-history removal, swap, information-preserving whole-motif shuffle and ambiguous-history controls in joint; verify their labels and nuisance balance. Extract only arrived audio through the guarded chunk-only API. Fsync append-only forecasts before reveal/extraction of the continuation; verify unrevealed-future invariance and process isolation. Score target windows fixed before evaluation and disjoint from forecast inputs.

PREREGISTER AND FREEZE

Before generating/exposing evaluation waveforms, post a PR #2 receipt linking exact protocol/code/config/split/model hashes, candidate grid and selected policy, probability coordinates/calibration, latency, resource ledger, event matching, all metrics/gates, bootstrap seed/quantiles and diagnostic branches. Development selects policy; calibration may perform only preregistered integrity/probability checks (no policy selection). Keep historical retrieval probabilities unchanged for the primary comparison. All evaluation is one pass, no replacement groups, tuning, repaired retest or weakened gates.

Analyze equally by phrase group using 5,000 paired group bootstrap samples and familywise intervals for four repaired-minus-oracle comparisons. Report accuracy, both-members success, log loss and Brier for EVERY front/model/cell/control, event F1/split/merge, pitch availability/error/octaves, support duration, missing-measurement counts, causal latency, measured processing time, storage and all safety subfamilies separately. Baseline superiority is a valid outcome. Numerical score comparisons may use a declared <=1e-12 absolute tolerance; immutable artifact/hash comparisons remain exact.

ADOPTION GATES — ALL REQUIRED FOR A

Validity: fresh separated groups; preregistration; balanced paired bytes/current probe; causal API/isolation and pre-reveal logs; future invariance; equal accessible memory; exact historical source/config hashes; correct control semantics; all resource bounds; independent saved-result reconstruction.

Oracle paired success >=.80 in every cell; otherwise C.
Repaired paired success >=.80 in every cell; repaired-minus-oracle accuracy familywise lower95 >=-.10 in every cell.
Joint repaired advantage over present-only AND unchanged whole-span reference each has positive paired lower95 accuracy bound.
Joint proper-score increase versus oracle <=.10 log loss and <=.02 Brier.
Group-weighted event F1 >=.90; pitched-event accuracy within .35 semitone >=.95 (unavailable/missing events count as failures); split/merge rates each <=.05; octave-error rate <=.01.
Actual arrived-audio decision latency <=160ms, with computation/dispatch timing reported separately; never backdate derived support or contextual features.
Reset/removal paired success <=.10, accuracy <=.55 and paired forecast TV <=1e-9; swap counterpart distribution error <=1e-9 and paired success >=.80; shuffle accuracy drop <=.10; ambiguous alternatives mass >=.90, each within .10 of .5, max class probability <=.60.
No preregistered safety subfamily loses >.10 group-mean accuracy versus oracle. No loss of the separately preserved original observations/realization records.

If oracle passes but A fails, select B (or inconclusive when invalid/insufficient); report which gates and whether the changed support actually reduced pitch errors without asserting it is the sole cause. No significance-versus-nonsignificance substitution for noninferiority.

RESOURCES, PUBLICATION AND STOP

<=1,000 total episode/control/invariance streams; <=2 hours aggregate local compute; <=2GiB new artifacts; <=32 arrived chunks per forecast, <=2-second completed waveform units. Reserve evaluation budget first; count every acoustic execution/probe and all candidate computations; do not split a study to evade caps. Count all predictor-accessible raw buffers, recurrent state, event records, alternative fronts and caches; evaluator archive inaccessible. This short-history test makes no eviction/long-term-retention claim.

No spending, paid compute/fallback, limit increases, purchased/reset credits, foundation training, MERT changes/downloads, deployment, force push or signal-only commits. If necessary evidence or a resource is unavailable, preserve recoverable progress and report the concrete blocker/known reset information; no busy retries or recreation of historical evidence.

Publish ONE complete successor targeting main: code, frozen protocol/configs, input recipes/hashes, archived evidence and acoustic caches, support provenance, pre-reveal logs, independent validation, group/model/control results, concise report, original execution-versus-publication provenance, checksums, checkpoint and ordinary PROJECT_STATE.md update. Keep its top transformed-recognition goal, finite capability checklist and first-release plan; update only demonstrated status, not permanent genre restrictions. No documentation-only PR.

New PR: draft -> earworm-review-ready label -> ready. For a matching active ready PR, push only the complete labeled update. Link exact head, execution revision, output paths and PR here. Save awaiting-review, release lock and stop this invocation. Preserve the existing 30-minute continuation and processed-instruction tracking; no reviewer/worker duplication, wake-up or schedule change.
